question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Brazen
solution:
The correct answer is: **Bold**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**brazen**" means **bold or shameless**, often to the point of being audacious or impudent. (निर्भीक या बेशर्म है)
 
• It suggests a lack of embarrassment or hesitation in one's actions or behaviour.
 
• **Synonyms of brazen** include audacious, shameless, and impudent.
 
 
• **Example**: *She displayed brazen confidence when addressing a large audience, speaking without any signs of nervousness.*
 
 
 
• In this context, "**brazen**" is synonymous with "**bold**" because both words convey a sense of fearlessness and a willingness to take risks or act with confidence, even in challenging situations.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

• **Loyal**, means faithful or dedicated. (वफादार)
 
• **Meek**, means submissive or gentle. (निरहंकार)
 
• **Courteous**, means polite or well-mannered. (विनम्र)
